description:
Build a curated test corpus exercising RFC 6125 hostname binding through `verify_tls_server` (and `verify_tls_client_dns` once shipped per PKIX-fmtv.11.2 client-half).

**Created 2026-05-12** as part of PKIX-fmtv.17's rescope decision (Mark, attended session). Supersedes the "PKITS through verify_tls_server" half of .17 — PKITS leaves lack SAN and EKU, so PKITS regression at the wrapper layer is structurally infeasible without re-issuing every leaf. Wrapper-level differential testing requires a SAN-bearing curated corpus.

## Coverage

**RFC 6125 §6.4.1 — exact-match dNSName SANs**
- positive: SAN `foo.example.com`, hostname `foo.example.com`
- negative: SAN `bar.example.com`, hostname `foo.example.com`

**RFC 6125 §6.4.2 — wildcard matching**
- positive: SAN `*.example.com`, hostname `foo.example.com`
- negative: SAN `*.example.com`, hostname `example.com` (wildcard does not match parent)
- negative: SAN `*.example.com`, hostname `foo.bar.example.com` (wildcards match single label only)
- negative: SAN `f*o.example.com`, hostname `foo.example.com` (partial-label wildcards reject per RFC 6125 §7.2)

**RFC 6125 §6.4.3 — leftmost-label-only wildcard pinning**
- negative: SAN `foo.*.example.com`, hostname `foo.bar.example.com`

**IDN / Punycode (RFC 5891)**
- positive: A-label SAN `xn--bcher-kva.example` matching A-label hostname `xn--bcher-kva.example`
- caller-side U-label normalization documented (wrapper expects pre-normalized ServerName::dns_name)

**IP literal SANs (RFC 5280 §4.2.1.6)**
- positive: iPAddress SAN matches IP literal hostname
- negative: iPAddress SAN mismatch
- negative: malformed iPAddress extension

**Case folding (RFC 4343)**
- positive: SAN `FOO.example.com`, hostname `foo.example.com`

**SAN-absent rejection (RFC 6125 §6.4.4)**
- negative: leaf with CN-only subject (no SAN extension), hostname `foo.example.com` MUST reject

## Source

x509-limbo's `webpki` test corpus has RFC 6125 cases. Pre-filter to RFC 6125-relevant cases; supplement with hand-curated cases for gaps (IDN, IP literal). x509-limbo is already pulled in by pkix-difftest, so consuming it doesn't add a new dependency.

## Fixtures

Generate via the existing pyca/cryptography fixture-generation tooling in pkix-chain/tests/fixtures-tools/ (or wherever the current generation lives — leaf-tls-server.der etc. came from somewhere). Each fixture = leaf cert (with specified SAN) + chain + expected verdict + hostname-to-bind metadata.

Fixture metadata format: small TOML / JSON manifest alongside the .der files describing each case's hostname-to-bind and expected verdict. Loadable by the test harness.

## Tests

Parameterized test driving the corpus. Each case:
1. Load chain + anchors from fixture
2. Parse hostname via `ServerName::dns_name(hostname)?`
3. Call `verify_tls_server(chain, anchors, &server_name, &BasicTlsProfile, NOW, &NoRevocation)`
4. Assert verdict matches expected

## Acceptance

Pass-rate baseline tracked in pkix-chain/tests/hostname_corpus_baseline.md (or pkix-difftest baseline file if cross-crate).

## Out of scope

- Differential testing against OpenSSL / pyca — that's PKIX-fmtv.18 / .19 consuming this corpus.
- verify_tls_client_dns coverage — uses the same corpus, but is gated on PKIX-fmtv.11.2's client half shipping first.
- Mailbox / rfc822Name binding — that's PKIX-fmtv.21.
title: Curated RFC 6125 hostname corpus + verify_tls_server tests
